# Team asset register {#sec-assets}

## Tier 3 assets

The Flood Warning Asset Governance companion (`companions/flood-warnings.qmd`)
is currently scope-only. Until it is complete, governance of these assets
defaults to the core framework.

| Asset | Type | Register entry | Custodian |
|---|---|---|---|
| Warning threshold configurations | Dataset/Config | [Register location] | [Named Custodian] |
| Warning issuance tooling | Tool | Tool Register | [Named Custodian] |

## Shared dataset consumption

These datasets are governed by the CDT Steward. The Warning Team's role
is Custodian only.

| Dataset | Shared Asset Register entry | Team Custodian contact |
|---|---|---|
| Gauge metadata | Shared Asset Register | [Named Custodian] |
| Catchment shapefiles | Shared Asset Register | [Named Custodian] |
